title: Webhook v2 subscription DTO (B.5, /webhooks)
description: Owned by the integration key that created it; disabled when the key is revoked. `secret` is returned ONCE, by POST /webhooks and POST /webhooks/:id/rotate-secret only. The HMAC key is the UTF-8 bytes of that string exactly as returned (do not base64-decode it).

events.description: Catalog types or `<domain>.*` wildcards. task.runtime_updated is delivered only when named explicitly.

organizationIds.description: Subset of the key's pinned organizations.

excludeOriginTags.description: Events whose origin.tag is in this list are not delivered (loop prevention), e.g. ["gauzy:<connectionId>"].

secret.description: Only in the POST /webhooks and rotate-secret responses.
